svg.text: Batch image upscaling with Real-ESRGAN, running on your own machine. Point it
at a file, a folder or a zip. GFPGAN face restoration is there if you want it.
It finds your GPU on its own and falls back to CPU, processes large images in
tiles so it does not run out of memory, and copies inputs to a temp workspace
so the originals are never touched. Docker image included if you would rather
